Gross County Product: county GDP from the KNBS reports

Source: R/reports.R
knbs_gcp.Rd

The size of each county's economy, from the Gross County Product reports KNBS publishes each year: GCP at current or constant prices, each county's share of gross value added, or per-capita GCP, for the 47 counties and Kenya, with the counties' 2019 census codes.

Usage

knbs_gcp(
  measure = c("gcp", "share", "per_capita"),
  prices = c("current", "constant"),
  edition = "latest",
  cache = knbs_option("cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

measure

"gcp" (KSh million), "share" (percent of gross value added) or "per_capita" (KSh).

prices

"current" or "constant"; ignored for shares.

edition

"latest", "all", or edition years such as 2024.

cache

Whether to use the local cache.

refresh

Whether to re-download the report and re-extract.

Value

A knbs_report_table tibble with columns geo_code, county, period, value, measure, prices, base_year, unit, status, edition, table_id and source_id.

Details

Each edition covers five to eight years and revises the years before it. edition = "latest" (the default) returns the newest edition that has the measure; edition = "all" returns every edition, one block per edition, so that revisions can be compared; or name the editions wanted.

Constant prices are 2009 prices in the 2019 edition and 2016 prices from the 2021 edition on, after the national accounts were rebased; the base_year column says which. Figures from editions with different base years must not be spliced into one series.

Per-capita GCP is published only in the 2019 edition. County shares are returned for single years; each report's average over its years is in knbs_report_table().

See also

knbs_report_table() for any single curated table, knbs_county_population() for the reports' population tables.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
gcp <- knbs_gcp()
real <- knbs_gcp(prices = "constant")
shares <- knbs_gcp("share", edition = "all")
}
